contracts: Each selected controller reuses its actual typed readonly operations table and existing private provider layout; no dynamic registry or forwarding layer is introduced.
Constructor effects participate in retained reverse cleanup; successful source drain clears only the live-provider marker, and failed NVIC, pin or gate withdrawal keeps independent lease markers.

I2C child port and address are statically bound before hardware startup; existing mutable endpoint storage moves from BSS to DATA without increasing RAM, but ROM initialization cost must be measured in the maintained ARM graph.
Every physical platform cold start and stop rejects ISR, incoming mask and unprivileged owners before system, clock, pin or vector effects; Native retains its host contract.

Eighteen literal maintained TOMLs cover three exact parts, two authored backends, finite five-controller DMA and paired I2C IRQ/DMA graphs; software Board fixtures do not establish PCB or electrical wiring.
limits: Final source hashes bind the fresh final 351-test execution and retained byte capsules, not retroactively earlier raw-only logs.
Historical commands, raw logs and independently owned GoogleTest source capsules preserve their original scope; no unavailable invocation or pre-execution identity is invented.
Actual generated GoogleTest and sanitizer results are archived by independent owners; their historical closure is not silently replaced with this later final tool closure.

Installed SDK and full maintained ARM graph execution remain separate qualification tasks; this archive establishes no clean Git candidate, reproducibility, physical HIL, safety certification or product release.
